text:
Sam Berman: FYI we're getting a sustained p95/p99 regression on /v1/generate in us-west-2 starting ~10:05. Multiple customers reporting 10-20s responses and a few 504s. Queue length at ingress spiked.
Marta Liu: which model/route and customer examples? Any recent deploys? :eyes:
Sam Berman: Route = /v1/generate, model = rw-small-1.2-q, region us-west-2. No deploys in the last hour (checked deploy-bot). Customer A repro: POST 2024-06-20T10:08Z, 12s p99. Stack: increased queue_depth metric from 40->620 in ~4m.
Jin Park: grabbing traces/metrics. Can you post the prometheus query or logs? Also what's current admission limit per worker?
Sam Berman: prometheus: rate(requests_in[1m]) up 3x, request_queue_size gauge -> 620. admission_limit=64 per worker. Attached snippet:
```
# promql
increase(redwood_ingress_requests_total[5m])
redwood_ingress_queue_size{region=\"us-west-2\"}
```
Taylor Nguyen: trying quick mitigations: 1) lower admission_limit to 32 for us-west-2; 2) enable soft-fallback to rw-medium-1 to free GPU memory; 3) temporarily increase dedicated pool by 2 instances. Which is easiest now?
Marta Liu: lowering admission limit is fastest. Jin/Taylor can you apply and watch p95? Also enable prefix-KV caching for hot tenants if possible.
Jin Park: applying admission policy patch now via control plane API.
Jin Park: `curl -X POST https://control.redwood.internal/policies/admission -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -d '{"region":"us-west-2","admission_limit":32}'` -> 200
eng-oncall-bot: :rotating_light: alert acknowledgment: incident 20240620-ingress-1729123456 created, incident channel #inc-1729123456
Taylor Nguyen: scaling dedicated pool +2 (k8s scale command) and enabling fallback for route.
Taylor Nguyen: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment/dedicated-pool-usw2 --replicas=6`
Sam Berman: after admission_limit change p95 dropped from 10.8s -> 4.1s within 90s. p99 still ~9s but trending down. Customers reporting improved UX.
Marta Liu: great. Can we put an automatic admission throttle when queue_size>300? Create ticket to add threshold-based auto-mitigation.
Sam Berman: created ticket RDW-INC-4871 with notes and initial graphs. Added ETA for RCA tomorrow EOD.
Jin Park: capturing logs for repro and saving traces to s3://rdw-incidents/1729123456
support-bot: Notifying affected customers list: AcmeCorp, BetaApps. Templates sent.
Sam Berman: will keep monitoring. Novelty: saw a small spike of very large requests (token count > 8k) causing KV cache churn.
Marta Liu: action items: (1) short-term: keep admission_limit=32 for 30m, (2) follow-up: implement queue-based auto-throttle, (3) RCA: investigate tokenizer-edge requests and add request size guardrails.
Taylor Nguyen: +1. I'll also add a quick rate-limit rule to reject requests > 6k tokens with 429 and helpful message.
Sam Berman: thanks all — marking thread resolved for now. :thumbsup:
